'''Tsubaki Shrine''' (椿神社) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s across Japan.

* {{ill|Tsubaki Shrine (Ōta)|ja|椿神社 (大田区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsubaki Shrine (Ōta)|qq=}} - A shrine located in [[:en:Ōta|Ōta]], {{ill|Tokyo|en|Tokyo|qid=Q1490|lt=Tokyo|1=Tokyo}}.
* Tsubaki Shrine - A common name for {{ill|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|en|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|qid=Q3541617|lt=Tsubaki Grand Shrine|1=Tsubaki Grand Shrine}} in {{ill|Suzuka|en|Suzuka|qid=Q406474|lt=Suzuka|1=Suzuka}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|en|Mie Prefecture|qid=Q128196|lt=Mie Prefecture|1=Mie Prefecture}}.
** Tsubaki Shrine - Shrines dedicated to {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|lt=Sarutahiko Ōkami|lt=Sarutahiko|ja|猿田彦神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sarutahiko|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to サルタヒコ}} across Japan, though few are directly related to the Tsubaki Ōkami Yashiro.
* Tsubaki Shrine - An alternate name for {{ill|Iyozuhiko-no-Mikoto Shrine|ja|伊豫豆比古命神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Iyozuhiko-no-Mikoto Shrine|qq=}} in {{ill|Matsuyama|en|Matsuyama|qid=Q200022|lt=Matsuyama|1=Matsuyama}}, {{ill|Ehime Prefecture|en|Ehime Prefecture|qid=Q123376|lt=Ehime Prefecture|1=Ehime Prefecture}}.
